items: Data centers contributed 7% to SRP's summer 2026 peak demand record and are projected to be SRP's fastest-growing customer segment.
Large load customers (those with at least 20 megawatts of forecasted load), including data centers, require new infrastructure to meet their needs.

SRP recently took additional steps to further protect residential customers from cost shifts associated with adding new large load customers: In 2025, SRP introduced the Large Customer Integration Process to address requests for electricity for new large business customers such as data centers.
Some of the larger data centers currently in SRP’s system have a capacity load of 200 MW.
